label: The regulatory deposit convention's four parameters (cap on the marginal pass-through, cap on the core share, prescribed average life of the core ladder, number of rungs)
source: Stated inputs to the convention, not derived by the replica: the engine's own defaults, read off the engine before any document stated them, and restated here so that both sides read the same four numbers (docs/oss/mid-size-bank.md, method note M8). The replica checks that the engine applies them; it does not check that they are right.
